key_idea: A day has only 86400 seconds, so expand each spec into explicit hour/minute/second lists and mark a boolean array.
sketch: Parse each token: '*' expands to the full range, otherwise split on commas and expand a-b ranges. Total job starts is the sum of |H|*|M|*|S| over specs; distinct seconds is the count of marked entries in an 86400-sized array after marking h*3600+m*60+s for every combination. Worst case 100*86400 marks, trivial. Only pitfall is the parsing (single value vs range vs star).
